Iron in Our Blood
Click 🎧 to listen.
Listen to a conversation between two students. The boy is discussing his opinion about where the elements in everything come from. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the boy gives to support his opinion. As you listen, you may take notes.
Listen to the Conversation

Answer all 4 questions to submit.
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
SMART SUPPORT:
